id: 33_SAFETY QUIZ SAFETY OFFICER SAFETY QUIZ MCQs Safety Quiz with Answer and Explanat
title: 安全管理十问
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/33_SAFETY QUIZ SAFETY OFFICER SAFETY QUIZ MCQs Safety Quiz with Answer and Explanat.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/33_SAFETY QUIZ SAFETY OFFICER SAFETY QUIZ MCQs Safety Quiz with Answer and Explanat/src.py

points.K1: 测验形式：四选一带解释

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上写着问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with a big question mark drawn on it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全管理十问，一起来答！

shots.scene: 一排图标：职责、放大镜、金字塔、锁、审核表
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a badge, a magnifier, a pyramid, a padlock and an audit checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 职责、分析、控制、审核、报告。

shots.scene: 小研戴着安全员袖标，走进实验室
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a blank safety officer armband, walks into a laboratory.
shots.narration: 小研刚当上实验室安全员。

shots.scene: 阿杰问：安全员到底管什么
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks her a question with a curious shrug.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：安全员到底要管什么？

shots.scene: 王老师递来一张空白题卡
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the female graduate student a blank quiz card.
shots.narration: 王老师说：做完这十题就清楚了。

shots.section_title: 测验形式：四选一带解释
shots.scene: 题卡：四个选项框和一个灯泡
shots.prompt_en: A quiz card with four empty option boxes and a light bulb icon. No people.
shots.narration: 每题四选一，答完讲原因。
overlay: 测验形式：四选一带解释

shots.scene: 四张职责卡：评估、法规、生产、调查
shots.prompt_en: Four duty cards: a risk scale, a rule book, a production line and a magnifier. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：哪项不是安全员的主要职责？

shots.scene: 生产线卡片被圈出
shots.prompt_en: The production line card is circled; the other three have green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 盯生产进度不是安全员的事。

shots.scene: 小研做风险评估、查法规、调查事件
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills a blank risk form, checks a rule book and examines a small spill area.
shots.narration: 评估风险、查合规、调查事故，才是。

shots.scene: 老周站在实验室中央，胸前有负责人牌
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands in the middle of the laboratory wearing a blank lab head badge.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人是第一责任人。

shots.scene: 小研把实验步骤拆成几格，每格旁画警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes procedure steps in boxes, adding a warning triangle beside each box.
shots.narration: 第二题：工作安全分析为了什么？

shots.scene: 钱袋、评分表、广告图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A money bag, a performance chart and a megaphone icon, all crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 一步一步找危害，再定措施。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔五层：消除、替代、工程、管理、防护
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid with five layers, widest at the top, each with an icon: a cross, a swap arrow, a fume hood, a clipboard and goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：哪种控制最有效？

shots.scene: 最上层“消除”发光
shots.prompt_en: The top layer of the inverted pyramid glows. No people.
shots.narration: 消除危害最有效，从根上去掉。

shots.scene: 小研把一瓶高危试剂换成低危试剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student replaces a bottle with a skull pictogram by a bottle with a milder pictogram.
shots.narration: 实验室里：换低危试剂、少用量。

shots.scene: 护目镜在最下层
shots.prompt_en: Safety goggles shown at the narrow bottom layer of the pyramid. No people.
shots.narration: 防护用品是最后一道防线。

shots.scene: 老李给真空泵电源上锁挂牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts a padlock and a blank tag on the power switch of a vacuum pump.
shots.narration: 第四题：LOTO是什么？

shots.scene: 锁和牌，旁边开关被禁止
shots.prompt_en: A padlock and tag on a switch with a crossed-out hand icon pressing it. No people.
shots.narration: 上锁挂牌，修好之前不能启动。

shots.scene: 小研翻开一份多页的空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank multi-page data sheet next to a chemical bottle.
shots.narration: 第五题：SDS的主要目的？

shots.scene: 四个图标：性质、搬运、储存、应急
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a molecule, hands carrying a bottle, a cabinet and a first aid cross. No people.
shots.narration: 性质、操作、储存、应急，都写清。

shots.scene: 着装、组织架构、培训档案图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A clothing icon, an org chart and a file folder, all crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不是着装规定，也不是培训档案。

shots.scene: 王老师拿检查表在实验室逐项查
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks through a laboratory ticking a blank audit checklist.
shots.narration: 第六题：安全审核为了什么？

shots.scene: 检查表上一项打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A checklist with most items ticked and one item marked with a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 找出不符合标准、没执行的地方。

shots.scene: 小研整改后拍照记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fixes the issue and records it with a blank form.
shots.narration: 找到就整改，记录在案。

shots.scene: 小研和同学们站着围成一圈说话
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student chats with students standing in a small circle before work.
shots.narration: 第七题：班前会有什么意义？

shots.scene: 设备保养、绩效考核图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A maintenance wrench icon and a performance review icon, both crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 轻松聊危害、讲程序、提意识。

shots.scene: 一个人手受伤、一个人咳嗽、一个险情警示
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an injured hand, a coughing person and a near-miss warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：伤害报告法规讲什么？

shots.scene: 原题外国法规卡片打问号
shots.prompt_en: A blank foreign law card with a question mark over it. No people.
shots.narration: 原题考外国法规，我们看国内。

shots.scene: 报告链：实验室、学院、保卫处
shots.prompt_en: A reporting chain of three icons joined by arrows: a laboratory, a college building and a security shield. No people.
shots.narration: 事故按规定报，学校里逐级报告。

shots.scene: 记录本上登记
shots.prompt_en: A blank incident record book being filled in. No people.
shots.narration: 伤害、疾病、险情都要登记。

shots.scene: 小研在实验室查看插座、溶剂柜和热源
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student inspects sockets, a solvent cabinet and a hot plate in the lab.
shots.narration: 第九题：火灾风险评估为了什么？

shots.scene: 灭火技能、保险费、报警器单项图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A firefighter skill icon, an insurance icon and an alarm-only icon, all crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 识别并管控火灾隐患，保人员安全。

shots.scene: 小研观察同学操作，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student watches the young male student working safely and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 第十题：行为安全关注什么？

shots.scene: 罚单图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A penalty ticket icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不是罚人，是改变行为和态度。

shots.scene: 好习惯一格格累积成盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Small habit icons stack up into a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 好习惯多了，事故就少了。

shots.section_title: 测验形式：四选一带解释
shots.scene: 小研合上题卡，对阿杰点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the quiz card and nods to the young male student.
shots.narration: 十题答完，安全员的活清楚了。

shots.scene: 老周咳嗽，手上起皮疹
shots.prompt_en: The older man coughs and looks at a rash on his hand.
shots.narration: 长期接触某些化学品，可能得职业病。

shots.scene: 老周去医务室就诊
shots.prompt_en: The older man visits a clinic and talks with a doctor.
shots.narration: 怀疑和工作有关，及时就医说明。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白报告表上登记
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator fills in a blank report form.
shots.narration: 疑似职业病，按规定报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰个子高，在矮台面前弓着腰操作
shots.prompt_en: The tall young male student hunches over a low lab bench while working.
shots.narration: 台面太矮，腰背受累。

shots.scene: 小研个子矮，坐在高台面前耸肩
shots.prompt_en: The shorter female graduate student sits at a high bench with raised shoulders.
shots.narration: 台面太高，肩膀受累。

shots.scene: 两人调整座椅高度和脚踏
shots.prompt_en: Both adjust their chair heights; the female graduate student adds a footrest.
shots.narration: 调座椅、加脚踏，手肘与台面齐平。

shots.scene: 长时间站立处铺抗疲劳垫
shots.prompt_en: An anti-fatigue mat placed in front of a standing workstation. No people.
shots.narration: 按人调设备，不让人迁就设备。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔、检查表、报告链三图并排
shots.prompt_en: Three images side by side: an inverted pyramid, a checklist and a reporting chain. No people.
shots.narration: 先消除、勤审核、快报告。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰一起开班前会
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student chat at the start of the day.
shots.narration: 班前聊安全，好习惯天天养。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the whiteboard.
shots.narration: 管理做细，安全做实！
